From f8ada189550984ee21f27be736042b74a7da1d68 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2017 15:39:26 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] arm64: perf: remove unsupported events for Cortex-A73

bus access read/write events are not supported in A73, based on the
Cortex-A73 TRM r0p2, section 11.9 Events (pages 11-457 to 11-460).

Fixes: 5561b6c5e981 "arm64: perf: add support for Cortex-A73"
Acked-by: Julien Thierry <julien.thierry@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Signed-off-by: Will Deacon <will.deacon@arm.com>

diff --git a/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c b/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
index 9eaef51f83ff..3affca3dd96a 100644
--- a/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
+++ b/arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c
@@ -262,12 +262,6 @@ static const unsigned armv8_a73_perf_cache_map[PERF_COUNT_HW_CACHE_MAX]
 
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_RD,
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
 };
 
 static const unsigned armv8_thunder_perf_cache_map[PERF_COUNT_HW_CACHE_MAX]
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm64/kernel/perf_event.c`**
   - Removed the following lines related to bus access read/write events for Cortex-A73:
     ```c
     [C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
     [C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
     [C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
     [C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modifications in `perf_event.c` are aimed at removing unsupported performance events for the Cortex-A73 processor. The removed lines specifically pertain to bus access read and write events, which are not supported according to the Cortex-A73 Technical Reference Manual (TRM). This change is a corrective action to ensure that the performance monitoring features accurately reflect the capabilities of the Cortex-A73, thereby fixing a bug introduced in a previous commit (identified by the hash `5561b6c5e981`).

Here is the commit message:
arm64: perf: remove unsupported events for Cortex-A73

bus access read/write events are not supported in A73, based on the
Cortex-A73 TRM r0p2, section 11.9 Events (pages 11-457 to 11-460).

Fixes: 5561b6c5e981 "arm64: perf: add support for Cortex-A73"
Acked-by: Julien Thierry <julien.thierry@arm.com>
Signed-off-by: Xu YiPing <xuyiping@hisilicon.com>
Signed-off-by: Will Deacon <will.deacon@arm.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the inclusion of unsupported bus access read/write events for the Cortex-A73 processor in the performance event mapping. These events were incorrectly added despite the Cortex-A73 Technical Reference Manual indicating that such events are not supported, leading to potential inaccuracies in performance monitoring.

Here is the patch:
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_RD,
 	[C(L1D)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_L1D_CACHE_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
-
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)]	= ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
-	[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
 };

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
```
Reason:
These statements incorrectly map unsupported bus access read/write events for the Cortex-A73 processor, despite the Cortex-A73 Technical Reference Manual indicating that such events are not supported. This inclusion can lead to inaccuracies in performance monitoring.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
[C(NODE)][C(OP_READ)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_RD,
[C(NODE)][C(OP_WRITE)][C(RESULT_ACCESS)] = ARMV8_IMPDEF_PERFCTR_BUS_ACCESS_WR,
```
Reason:
The removal of these statements eliminates the mapping of unsupported bus access events, ensuring that only valid performance events are included for the Cortex-A73 processor, thus aligning with the specifications in the Technical Reference Manual and preventing inaccuracies in performance monitoring.
